name: ohyeah-achacha-logo-v1
channel: オーイェーのアチャチャチャンネル
intended_use: Channel logo generation for OhYeahAchacha YouTube channel

model_recommendation.notes: Use any SD1.5 or SDXL checkpoint optimised for flat illustration or vector-like output (e.g. ToonYou, CounterfeitXL, AnythingXL).

design_intent.text_layout: オーイェーの (small, top) + アチャチャチャンネル (large, main)
design_intent.font_style: quirky-cute — between kitschy/retro and kawaii (e.g. RocknRoll One, Rampart One, 851手書き雑フォント)
design_intent.note: SD/SDXL cannot reliably render Japanese text. Generate decorative elements in ComfyUI, then overlay Japanese text with a design tool (Canva, Figma, etc.).

prompts.positive: masterpiece, best quality, channel logo emblem, quirky cute pop style, bold thick outlines, vibrant warm colors, high contrast, transparent background, clean vector-like illustration, flat shading, cheerful energetic mood, playful retro kawaii aesthetic, decorative frame, no text, no background, cutout style, bright saturated palette, yellow orange accent colors
prompts.negative: photorealistic, realistic texture, 3d render, text, letters, watermark, signature, busy background, gradient background, white background, black background, cluttered composition, muted colors, low contrast, blur, noise

color_variants.full_color: vibrant yellow orange red palette, saturated colors
color_variants.white_on_dark: white fill, dark thick outline, high contrast

adjustment_guide.more_pop: Add pop art, halftone dots, bold comic style and raise cfg to 7.5.
adjustment_guide.more_outline: Append thick black outline, stroke border, outlined art style to positive prompt.
adjustment_guide.more_transparent: Post-process with background removal (rembg or similar) if alpha output is unavailable.
adjustment_guide.lora_notes: For LoRA training start with network_dim=32, lr=1e-4, 1500 steps, 15-30 style-consistent reference images.
